name: rate-limit-429
description: The first call returns HTTP 429 with a rate_limit_error body and a retry-after header of 2 seconds. The next call returns a normal weather reply, and that success step then repeats.

error.body: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"rate_limit_error","message":"Rate limit reached. Please retry after a short wait."}}

respond.text: Tomorrow will be mild and dry, with a high near 18 C and a light breeze.
